section_summary.extract_value: This is an exploratory study by Kristen N. Jozkowski examining differences in body appreciation among women with different sexual orientations (heterosexual, bisexual, and other sexual minorities). The study found significant differences in body appreciation between sexual minority and heterosexual women when controlling for demographic characteristics, but no significant differences between bisexual women and other sexual minority women.
